takes.sourceDescription: Pick box up, bend from waist
takes.title: Lift an implied box with a waist bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends forward with soft knees, reaches down with both hands, then straightens and presents the hands forward before releasing.

takes.sourceDescription: Pick box up, bend from waist
takes.title: Waist-bend box pickup with a forward reach
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds low toward the floor, rises with the hands near the torso, then extends both forearms before returning to rest.

takes.sourceDescription: Pick box up, bend from waist
takes.title: Quick box pickup from a forward fold
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches low by hinging at the hips, brings the hands up near the chest, and lowers them after a short forward reach.

takes.sourceDescription: Pick box up, bend from waist
takes.title: Measured box pickup with a pause
takes.actionDescription: The performer pauses upright, folds deeply with both hands lowered, then rises and holds both hands forward before relaxing.

takes.title: Quick squat to lift an implied box
takes.actionDescription: The performer drops into a deep squat, reaches down between the knees, then stands and extends both hands forward.

takes.title: Squat pickup with a forward hand extension
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers with the knees bent, picks up with both hands, then straightens and briefly reaches forward before dropping the arms.

takes.title: Deep squat pickup with a chest-height hold
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches to the floor from a deep squat, rises with hands gathered near the chest, and gradually relaxes the arms.

takes.title: Squat pickup and quick release gesture
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers to the floor with the knees bent, stands with the hands together, then quickly extends and lowers both hands.

takes.sourceDescription: Pick box up, bend from waist
takes.title: Waist-bend pickup with extended forearms
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds forward to reach down, stands with the hands close to the torso, holds them out briefly, then lowers the arms.
